    The winding mesh weight of a periodic component (Proposition 7.5) #

    weights-and-parameters.tex (prop:primitive-parameter-characters): "Lift p_i to ℤΔ, starting at a vertex (x, j) over τv_i. Its endpoint lies over v_i […] The closed walk p_i t_{v_i}⁻¹ winds once around the component."

    Deviation: instead of identifying χ_i with a deck class and using a lemma on the periodic core, we construct, on a periodic component covered by ℤΔ with deck transformations (v, t) ↦ (ρ v, t + c₀), an integer mesh weight measuring this winding: an arrow lifted to X → Y gets weight ⌊Y_t / c₀⌋ − ⌊X_t / c₀⌋, which does not depend on the lift (floorWt). For the candidate row of a word of length c₀/2 + 1 (Appendix B) the weight of the row minus ν is one (floorWt_candRow).
